BiblicalUsage: Paul says they have heard of his conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how beyond measure he persecuted the church of God and wasted it — and he tells the Ephesians to put off, concerning the former conversation, the old man, corrupt according to the deceitful lusts. Timothy is told to be an example of the believers in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity; and Peter says, as He who called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation. The word is the whole conduct of a life: the old one put off, the new one an example, and holiness in all of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that conduct is the sermon people actually hear: Paul's old conversation persecuted the church, and his new one built it, and the difference was Christ. Timothy is told to be an example in conversation before anything else, and Peter says holiness belongs in all manner of it — not just on Sundays, but in the whole manner of living. I believe God cares about the way I live on a Tuesday as much as what I say on a Sunday.
